title: Device clouds and the compatibility matrix

videos.script: Your users do not own one phone. They own hundreds of models, from a handful of makers, on five or six versions of Android. {{many}} Multiply those by screen sizes and languages and the list runs into thousands. Nobody tests all of it. {{explode}} This lesson is about choosing. First from your own users. Their phones are the ones that matter, not the market's. {{users}} A short script reads an export of your analytics. It says which versions and which models cover most of the people. {{coverage}} Then a second script picks combinations so that every pair of values meets at least once. A dozen rows instead of seventy-two. {{pairwise}} And last, where the long tail is tested. Device clouds are real phones in a data centre, rented by the minute. {{clouds}} You will see what they offer, and what they cost you besides money. Then how the tests of lessons 15 and 16 are pointed at them. {{remote}}
